The plate is about 26 cm across, so I judged each item against that.

- **Pear:** it is about 7 cm across, so roughly 170 g at 50 kcal/100 g.
- **Bread with tomato spread:** a slice about 9 × 9 cm and 1.5 cm thick, so roughly 45 g of bread plus a little tomato spread. I counted it as one item at 250 kcal/100 g.
- **Chicken drumstick:** fried or roasted with skin. The visible portion is about 90 g edible at 220 kcal/100 g.
- **Chicken wing piece:** about 25 g at 250 kcal/100 g.
- **Breaded chicken piece:** about 40 g at 280 kcal/100 g.
